data.one_liner: Renders <math> tags in flutter_html using flutter_math_fork.
data.what_it_does: The package parses MathML inside <math> elements to TeX and displays it with flutter_math_fork. It integrates as an Html extension for flutter_html.
use_when: You need MathML support in flutter_html
You want to display equations without writing TeX manually
avoid_when: You only need simple HTML without math
You require full MathML feature parity
weaknesses: Partial MathML support may miss some features
Parsing errors require handling via onMathError
